local.sql: SELECT publication_number, title_en FROM publications WHERE len(title_en) > 0 AND regexp_matches(lower(title_en[1]), '(diagonal|caster|castor|steer|swivel|omnidirectional)') AND regexp_matches(lower(title_en[1]), '(assist|drive|motor|power)') ORDER BY publication_date DESC
